div.div: done and error are one-shot writes: they stand until the session itself does something new (a fresh turn reads working, Escape reads idle). Acting on the session is the acknowledgment; canopy has no dismiss key. blocked is transient: it clears on its own when the dialog closes. stopped (not drawn) is a display overlay over any state while the process is SIGSTOPped (the p key).
